component.name: Decentr Web Browser
component.summary: The web browser from Decentr project

description.p: Decentr is an open-source browser project that aims to build a safer, faster, and more stable way to experience the web.
We invite you to join our effort to build a powerful platform for developing a new generation of web applications.
Decentr supports Vorbis, Theora, WebM and HTML5 audio and video standards,
